title: Client Discovery Harness - Source Metadata
description: What is kept about an uploaded document. There is deliberately no filename field and no text field: the original name can itself be sensitive, and document text is never persisted in ephemeral mode. additionalProperties is false so that a well-meaning adapter cannot add one.

source_id.description: Random opaque id. Must not be derived from the uploaded filename.

display_label.description: A name the uploading person typed so they can recognise this source later. Never derived from the filename, never auto-filled, control characters stripped. It is not in the logging allowlist, and in PERSISTENT mode it is stored with the rest of this record - see docs/privacy.md.

processing_status.description: PURGED means extraction finished and the original was deleted - the normal terminal state in ephemeral mode.

error_code.description: Short non-sensitive code. Never an exception message, which can carry document content.
